items.headline: Average DAM (Southern proxy) MCP: Rs 5619.05/MWh
items.detail: Day-ahead market average clearing price for 2026-06-04 was Rs 5619.05/MWh across 96 15-min blocks (range Rs 1048.97-10000.0/MWh).

raw_values.region_note: Karnataka has no standalone day-ahead price; this uses the IEX Southern-region area clearing price as a proxy (see scope-note.md).

items.headline: Peak-hour (18:00-24:00) MCP premium: +64.8% vs daily avg
items.detail: Peak-hour average MCP was Rs 9257.43/MWh vs the day's overall average of Rs 5619.05/MWh, a +64.8% divergence.

raw_values.region_note: Karnataka has no standalone day-ahead price; this uses the IEX Southern-region area clearing price as a proxy (see scope-note.md).

items.headline: Wide intraday MCP spread: 159% of daily average
items.detail: Max-min spread of Rs 10000.0 - Rs 1048.97 = 159% of the daily average, indicating high intraday volatility.
